input: I think the ci system we have by default using ci that is runnable locally not just on gha runners. optimizing it. in general.
task: Make the default CI runnable locally and optimise it

doc_friction.issue: Invariant 7's remedy said 'copy a sibling', which grew 802 per-venture copies of one node --test job that ventures-tests.yml already ran; now points at ventures-tests.yml and invariant 8 rejects copies.
Checklist said validate_workflows.py requires a <slug>-ci.yml for any venture with tests; untrue since ventures-tests.yml (2026-10-16). Rewritten.

deviations.why: The owner gave a direct CI task, so the run took the process track instead of the routed ventures draw.

notes: 549 -> 131 workflows (418 node --test-only per-venture copies removed; invariant 8 blocks regrowth). ventures-tests.yml now runs run_venture_tests.py, the same command used locally; run_workflow_locally.py resolves PR base/sha/workspace/runner.temp, so ventures-tests.yml runs 4/4 steps locally (0 before). Full venture sweep 1,315 suites in 12m53s; own-workflow ventures keep *.test.mjs-only to avoid their TS/npm suites. shift-roster-builder already red on main (5 runs).
